lib.gshoot.base.display.storydisplay_tex:
Indra soars across the sky. The screams of the people and
the darkness engulfing the sky are signals of the monster's revival.
Indra's sole purpose of being is to destroy that evil,
which threatens to swallow the world whole.

Goliath is the name of the battleship that protected people from the demon invasions.
The hero that was once celebrated as the Steel Guardian has now
become a den full of evil monsters. Deep inside, Vritra's presence can be felt.
Indra must find a way to infiltrate the den.

Sensing the strong presence of Vritra, Indra ventures inside Goliath.
The inside of the ship is infested with cellular fibers that likely belong to Vritra,
making it resemble the inside of a living organism.
He must be in here somewhere. But something feels strange.

The Forest Ruins commenced attack as if it were lying in wait for Indra.
Could this be another symptom of Vritra's return?
But time is of the essence. Nightfall is approaching.

The weapons of an ancient civilization gleam ominously in wait to eliminate all invaders.
Indra's strength has steadily diminished as he fights one fierce battle after another.
But he can't turn back now. He must defeat Vritra before nightfall.

A scorpion-shaped monster that was awakened by the return of Vritra.
The cursed monster awakens from its slumber in the depths of the earth to attack Indra.
Its tail, harder than steel, pierces and destroys all that stands in its way.

The fused form of Goliath's security system and a spider monster.
By crawling along its web, it can move freely through the air to prey upon invaders.
Its extremely hot silk instantly melts and reduces its prey to dust
rather than simply capturing them.

A clone of Vritra, created by Vritra himself. By multiplying its own
decaying flesh, it is engulfing Goliath, which shelters its spirit.
Even though its body is composed merely of bones and a small amount of
decaying flesh, it is no less powerful than Vritra himself.

A bee-shaped monster that guards the ancient ruins.
This extremely mobile monster can shoot projectiles from various angles,
turning its targets into beehives.The powerful lightning attacks that
it emits from time to time engulf everything, leaving not even a shadow.

A dragonfly-shaped monster that rules over the ancient ruins.
With its surveillance network that uses its many eyes,
it eliminates the remains of all intruders in the ancient ruins.
Escaping its pursuit is no easy feat.

Indra has finally reached his arch-enemy, Vritra.
But he must hurry. Once night falls, he will attain the unparalleled strength.
"Evil Dragon Vritra. My sole purpose of being is to destroy you."

Vritra's true form after being freed from the shackles of the sun and
releasing the power of darkness. The chances of defeating him are
close to zero. This is all the more reason why Indra must face him.
"Let's end this now... Let’s end the war that has haunted us for eternity."
